[[Brisbane Roar FC|Brisbane Roar]] were both the defending A-League Premiers and Champions. The regular season commenced on 10 October 2014 and concluded on 26 April 2015. The 2015 Grand Final took place on 17 May 2015. The season was suspended from 9–24 January in order to avoid a clash with the [[2015 AFC Asian Cup]], which was hosted by Australia.{{cite web|title=Season 2014/15 Hyundai A-League draw revealed|url=http://www.footballaustralia.com.au/news-display/season-2014/15-hyundai-a-league-draw-revealed/90818|publisher=footballaustralia.com.au|access-date=12 June 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141017213740/http://www.footballaustralia.com.au/news-display/season-2014/15-hyundai-a-league-draw-revealed/90818|archive-date=17 October 2014|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}} The [[2015 A-League Grand Final|2015 Grand Final]] took place on 17 May 2015, with [[Melbourne Victory]] claiming their third Championship with a 3–0 win against [[Sydney FC]].
